response.diary: Stern was crowded at dinner so I ate fast with my mask on, then studied at Mark Taper and went home. Feeling fine but still a bit anxious about illness going around.

I feel fine, so I'll stick with my usual routine, maybe studying a bit at Green Library instead of crowding. Keep it simple: eat, relax at Mark Taper, then home early.
